title: 第十一章 王国商队黄金骑士团第十二章 四阶御马兽人肉摊
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: “老师？”亚瑟看着对面那高挑动人的身影，一脸难以置信，“你……您竟然是他的老师。”
“哎哟！”亚瑟一时走神，被李奥一刀劈在了头顶，此时他捂着脑袋。
没想到这黑石城第一美女，黑石城堡的大小姐，拉福林骑士的女儿竟然成了这李奥的老师。
这到底是怎么回事。
“你没事吧。”李奥刚刚收了力，不过这一下打的结结实实，还是有点疼。
“你俩干什么呢！”伊芙将手抱在胸前，摆出老师的架子，厉声呵斥，“要练就好好练，这打打闹闹的是在干什么，浪费时间吗！”
亚瑟狠狠揉了揉脑袋，表情认真了起来。
在女人面前决不能出丑，尤其是漂亮女人，这是他的人生准则。
“那我可要用全力了。”亚瑟紧了紧手中的木剑，一步冲了出去，“开山十字剑！”
这一次，亚瑟的攻势明显迅猛了起来。
李奥见状扎住脚步，迎着攻势便是一记横斩。
铿！
两把剑撞在了半空，巨大的力量直接将他震退了两步。
好猛！
李奥捏了捏手掌，和亚瑟硬撼一剑，此时他感觉手掌发麻。
好强的力量。
这还是他昨晚吃了鲛人肉，达到1.0的力量属性，已经是一个正常成年人的水平。
却还是不及此时的亚瑟。
“注意你的脚步！拧身和出剑要一气呵成！”伊芙此时在一边指导着。
她刚刚已经看出，这亚瑟是有剑术基础的，甚至已经接触了进阶剑法，而且他的身体素质要强于李奥。
现在的李奥不是亚瑟的对手，差距不小，不是短时间能够追上的。
不过此时的李奥却是没有丝毫退缩，就是刚刚，他的经验条再次发生了滚动。
这是肝经验的绝好机会！
对面的亚瑟很满意自己刚才的一剑，瞟了眼一边养眼的美女老师。
雄性激素的作用下，此时的他也是斗志昂扬，“来！让你看看什么叫做实力。”
黑石城的夜晚清冷而静谧。
皎洁的弯月已然爬上柳梢。
时间在不知不觉中过去了三个小时。
马厩中，亚瑟单手杵着木剑，气喘吁吁。
而李奥虽然也是喘气连连，但明显还有余力，“来！这一剑让你看看我的实力。”
经过刚刚长达三小时的激烈对练，再加上伊芙的全程指导，李奥的基础剑术经验涨得飞快。
就在刚刚，这个技能已经成功升级到了二级。
基础剑术（白）二级1100（力量+0.2，基础剑术熟练度2级）
李奥感觉在自己脑海中，大量剑术经验的积累在一瞬间发生了质变，像是打破了一个瓶颈。
这些练习经验最后在体内融汇贯通，融入了自己的身体本能。
而李奥的力量也是再次提升。
“不来了不来了。”亚瑟一屁股坐在地上，他举着手里的木剑，“你自己看看。”
李奥此时才注意到亚瑟的剑早已布满了大大小小的缺口和裂纹。
亚瑟用手捏住剑刃轻轻一掰，咔地一声，他手中的木剑便直接断成了两截。
“见鬼，你这家伙体力怎么跟马似的。”亚瑟看着面前的李奥。
刚刚两人对练，一开始他还明显占据上风，所以他想尽办法想在伊芙面前尽量展示自己的剑招。
可随着时间推移，他发现这个李奥就像磨坊里的马一般，根本不知疲倦。
两人之间的差距竟然被李奥靠着耐力慢慢磨平了。
“好了，今晚就到这吧。”伊芙看了看夜空，已经很晚了。
content_en:
"Teacher?" Arthur looked at the tall and attractive figure opposite, with a look of disbelief on his face, "You...you are actually his teacher."
"Ouch!" Arthur was distracted for a moment and was hit on the head by Leo with a knife. At this time, he covered his head.
Unexpectedly, the most beautiful woman in Blackstone City, the eldest lady of Blackstone Castle, and the daughter of Knight Laughlin would actually become Leo's teacher.
What the hell is going on.
"Are you okay?" Leo just stopped his strength, but this time the blow was firm and it still hurt a little.
"What are you two doing!" Eve clasped her hands on her chest, pretending to be a teacher, and scolded sternly, "Practice hard if you want to, what are you doing with all this fighting, is it a waste of time!"
Arthur rubbed his head hard and his expression became serious.
He must never make a fool of himself in front of women, especially beautiful women. This is his rule of life.
"Then I have to use all my strength." Arthur tightened the wooden sword in his hand and rushed out, "Mountain Cross Sword!"
This time, Arthur's offensive became obviously rapid.
Seeing this, Leo stopped his steps and faced the attack with a horizontal slash.
Keng!
The two swords collided in mid-air, and the huge force knocked him back two steps.
So fierce!
Leo squeezed his palm and struck a blow with Arthur's sword. At this time, he felt his palm numb.
What a powerful force.
This is because he ate shark meat last night and reached a strength attribute of 1.0, which is already the level of a normal adult.
But it's still not as good as Arthur at this time.
"Watch your steps! Twist your body and draw the sword in one go!" Eve was guiding at this time.
She had just seen that Arthur had a foundation in swordsmanship and had even been exposed to advanced swordsmanship, and his physical fitness was stronger than Leo's.
The current Leo is no match for Arthur. The gap is not small and cannot be caught up in a short time.
But at this time, Leo did not flinch at all. Just now, his experience bar scrolled again.
This is a great opportunity for liver experience!
Arthur on the opposite side was very satisfied with his sword strike just now, and glanced at the beautiful teacher who was seducing him.
Under the influence of male hormones, he was also very motivated at this time, "Come! Let me show you what strength is."
The night in Black Rock City is cold and quiet.
The bright crescent moon has already climbed up the willow branches.
Three hours passed unconsciously.
In the stable, Arthur was holding a wooden sword with one hand, panting.
Although Leo was panting again and again, he obviously still had some energy left, "Come! This sword will show you my strength."
After just three hours of intense sparring, coupled with Eve's full guidance, Leo's basic swordsmanship experience increased rapidly.
Just now, this skill has been successfully upgraded to level two.
Basic swordsmanship (white) level 2 1100 (strength +0.2, basic swordsmanship proficiency level 2)
Leo felt that in his mind, the accumulation of a large amount of swordsmanship experience had undergone a qualitative change in an instant, as if a bottleneck had been broken.
These practice experiences are finally integrated into the body and integrated into one's own body instincts.
And Leo's power also increased again.
"I won't come, I won't come." Arthur sat down on the ground, holding up the wooden sword in his hand, "See for yourself."
Only then did Leo notice that Arthur's sword was already covered with large and small chips and cracks.
Arthur held the blade of the sword with his hand and gently broke it. With a click, the wooden sword in his hand broke into two pieces.
"Damn it, why do you have the physical strength of a horse?" Arthur looked at Leo in front of him.
The two of them had just been sparring, and he clearly had the upper hand at the beginning, so he tried his best to show off his sword skills in front of Eve.
But as time went by, he discovered that Leo was like a horse in a mill, tireless at all.
The gap between the two was slowly smoothed out by Leo's endurance.
"Okay, that's it for tonight." Eve looked at the night sky and saw that it was already very late.
